record.title: Falsify the persistent abstract-machine construction
record.intent: Determine what current taskctl plus a fixed INC/DECJZ/HALT execution unit can realize, and identify any minimum missing primitive without changing production semantics.
requirements: Own docs/experiments/TASKCTL-ABSTRACT-MACHINE.md, isolated conformance laboratory source/build wiring and captured evidence. Read current source and self-host graph.
No production protocol redesign, provider interpreter, v1 freeze, service implementation or unrelated migration. No hidden mutable execution state or precomputed result trace.
Keep prerequisites acyclic, dynamic history append-only, receipts immutable and writes CAS-controlled; distinguish semantic contracts from immutable full revisions.
acceptance: Run and capture transfer and branch-heavy specimens with one fixed instruction per fresh stepper invocation. Record frontier, branch, every CAS and immutable provenance.
Execute focused negative probes for boundaries actually found; provide exact current-source citations, a reduction or falsification, decidability consequences and a minimal recommendation.
Report executed tests, commits and tree state; leave the authorized migration sequence intact.
